## Summary

Describe what changed, why, and the expected result.

## Related issue

Link a GitHub issue, or explain why none is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Feature / standalone prototype
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Tests / tooling

## Verification

List automated tests, manual checks or technical validation performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Planned behavior is not presented as already implemented.
- [ ] No secrets, private information, copyrighted game files or unauthorized code are included.
- [ ] Documentation and tests were updated where appropriate.
- [ ] Licensing and game integration constraints were considered.
